The page number and running head are at the top right, and the gathering signature is at the foot. There are no marginal notes in text. main_text.p: Luciani Philopseude, μεταξὺ λεγομένων ἀπιστῶν, ὠχύ-μλω[?].

Pag. 25. καὶ ὡς ἐν ὑγρῷ ἔζιν ἡ γλαῦξ[?].] A. Gellius de linguofis iftis, libro primo, Quorum lingua, ait, tam prodiga infrenisque fit, vt fluat semper effluétque collatione verborum teterrima: quod genus homines à Graecis significantissimo vocabulo λάλος appellatos. Ibidem ait importunos iftos locutores verbis humidis & lapsantibus diffluere. quae vim verborum Theophrasti aptissime exprimunt. Perfius paullo aliter cùm ait,

p.i: Hoc natat in labris: & in vdo eft Maenas & Attin.

main_text.p:
— ὡς γὰρ λάλοισιν ἐξ ἄκρης
ἡ γλαῦξ ὡς ἂν τετευμένη[?].
Genus porrò loquendi quo hîc Theophrastus vtitur, ἐν ὑγρῷ ἡ γλαῦξ, memini obseruare apud Orum Apollinem: vt apud Cedrenum ὑγρὸν γλαῦξ[?].

τῆς χελιδόνων δόξειεν ἂν εἴη λαλίστερα[?].] Prouerbium eft, χελιδόνι λαλίστερα. Eft enim hirundo garrularum & κωτίλων auicularum: imò verò ἀλλ' μᾶλλον ἢ ἄλλη ὄρνις, inquit Arrianus libro primo. Alij tamen aliter prouerbium efferunt: vt τέτλα λαλίστερα: ficut apud Anacreontem. vel τευχόν λαλίστερα, vt notat Euftathius. vel etiam ἀνδρόν λαλίστερα: quò allusit Plautus Bacchidibus, initio. Alexis in Thrasone,

— σὺ δ' ἐγὼ λαλισέραν
Οὐ πώποτ' εἶδον, ὅτε κερκώσων γυναῖκα
Οὐ κίτταν, ὡς ἀνδρόν, ἡ τευχόν, ἡ τέτλα[?].
extat hic locus apud Athenaeum, lib. quarto, fed

page.notes: The Greek lines are the hardest passages on the page and several words are uncertain; each doubtful word is marked [?]. The top line of Greek ("ὠχύ-" / "μλω") is faint at the join. The hand-drawn pointing mark in the right margin beside the Greek verse is not printed text and was left out. The printed "Pag. 25." and the Persius lines are copied as they appear. The printed text ends mid-sentence ("sed"), which continues on the next page.
